svg.title: Mask scores before softmax
svg.desc: For query position two, replace future scores with negative infinity. Divide by square root of two and apply softmax to get weights 0.5517, 0.4483, zero, zero, zero, zero.

g.text: A shorter route: hide future scores, then apply softmax
Row 2 compares query 2 with all six keys.
2. Divide by √2, then softmax across each row
exp(−∞) = 0: future positions contribute nothing to softmax.
Each row sums to ≈ 1. No separate row-sum division is needed.
